summary.text: Greg Blanc is a Republican state senator from South Dakota's District 35 who took office on January 14, 2025, and a pastor.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026, Republican primary and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Blanc's career experience, according to Ballotpedia, includes working as a pastor and small business owner, and he has been affiliated with Calvary Chapel.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, he said he had been pastor of Calvary Chapel Community Church for 22 years, a Rapid City Police Department chaplain for 21 years, and a member of a human trafficking task force for eight years.
In the survey, he described himself as a conservative and a constitutionalist and a lifelong Republican.
In the 2025-2026 session Blanc serves on the Senate Judiciary, Military and Veterans' Affairs and Taxation committees and on the Senate Select Committee on the Nomination for Lieutenant Governor.
